This page lists the exercises of the course: a starter exercise, a starter kit and eight subject exercises. Each exercise trains one work step of historical research with AI systems. You need no knowledge of programming.

## How to Read an Exercise

Each exercise starts with the section "At a glance". This section names five items:

- **Duration**: the honest working time for the whole exercise.
- **Level**: Beginner, Intermediate or Advanced.
- **Core path**: the steps that lead to a complete result.
- **Optional deepening**: the steps that you can leave out.
- **Hand-in (minimum)**: what you present at the end.

The section "What you need" follows. It names the knowledge, the necessary capabilities of the AI system and the other tools. Read both sections before you start with step 1.

## Recommended Order

Start with the exercise [Set up your workspace](set-up-workspace.qmd). It settles account, law and AI log once for the whole course. Then comes [Prompt Engineering](prompt-engineering.qmd), the basis for all other exercises, with the [Dodis 5020 starter kit](starter-kit-dodis-5020.qmd). After it, the exercises follow the course of a research project:

1. [Prompt Engineering](prompt-engineering.qmd) – the shared basis (working material: [Dodis 5020 starter kit](starter-kit-dodis-5020.qmd)).
2. [Literature Research](literature-research-social-security-ch.qmd) – open up the state of research systematically.
3. [Research Question](formulating-historical-research-question-switzerland-council-of-europe.qmd) – turn the topic into a question that you can work on.
4. [Source Criticism](source-criticism-federal-council-council-of-europe-1949.qmd) – check and classify one single source. You need this reading skill for the next exercise.
5. [Source Search](source-search-vorort-council-of-europe-1963.qmd) – use this reading skill to find further primary sources and plan the access.
6. [Academic Writing](writing.qmd) – develop a text from your material.
7. [Citing](citing.qmd) – secure your references and disclose your own AI use.
8. [Public History](public-history.qmd) – translate the results for an audience.

You can also work on the exercises 2 to 8 one by one. The exercise [Citing](citing.qmd) is the exception. It needs your AI log from an earlier exercise.

::: callout-tip

## Plan the source search early

The exercise [Source Search](source-search-vorort-council-of-europe-1963.qmd) is a research project over several days. All other exercises take between one hour and one working day. Start the source search early when you work through the whole course in one semester.

:::
